title: Implement owner authentication and browser request protections
acceptance_criteria: Implement strict session/register/login/logout contracts with Argon2id, hashed revocable session tokens, idle/absolute expiry and rotation, standard errors, and no-store.

Enforce secure cookie settings with explicit loopback-only exception, exact Origin and session-bound CSRF including pre-login, bounded bodies, trusted proxy rules, and shared PostgreSQL account/IP rate limits.
On real PostgreSQL, show restart persistence, duplicate normalized email rejection, and denial for invalid Origin/CSRF, expired/revoked sessions, and exceeded rate caps.
deliverables: Owner auth routes, reusable guards, and real-DB auth evidence
